text.title: 收银台旁的订单
text.situation:
参观建筑后，林带着中心新茶角的清单去商店。预算中留了四十英镑买水壶。助手给她看两种型号，并拿出尚未到货型号的订单。林选了那一种，因为较宽的把手更适合团队计划的用途。她把表格放到收银台旁，询问价格。

助手：水壶四十英镑。订货时付十英镑定金，到货后付剩余的钱。
林：送货另外收费吗？
助手：是，送货五英镑，也可以来店自取。
林：我来取，能用信用卡付定金吗？
助手：能。我会把已付金额标在订单上。

水壶订单
价格：40英镑
已付定金：10英镑
取货时余款：30英镑
取货安排：收到到货消息时请联系我们
林把订单折好，与中心购物清单放在一起，茶角还要再等几天。

paragraphs.en: After the building visit, Lin stopped at the shop with a list for the centre’s new tea corner. Her budget allowed forty pounds for a kettle. The assistant showed her two models and an order form for the one not yet in stock. Lin chose that model because its wider handle was preferable for the way the team planned to use it. She put the form beside the till and asked about the price.
paragraphs.zh: 参观建筑后，林带着中心新茶角的清单去商店。预算中留了四十英镑买水壶。助手给她看两种型号，并拿出尚未到货型号的订单。林选了那一种，因为较宽的把手更适合团队计划的用途。她把表格放到收银台旁，询问价格。

paragraphs.en:
Assistant: The kettle is forty pounds. We ask for a ten-pound deposit when you order it, and you pay the rest when it arrives.
Lin: Do you charge extra for delivery?
Assistant: Yes. Delivery is five pounds, or you can collect it here.
Lin: I will collect it. Can I pay the deposit by credit card?
Assistant: Yes. I will mark the amount paid on the order form.

助手：能。我会把已付金额标在订单上。

paragraphs.en:
Kettle order
Price: £40
Deposit paid: £10
Balance on collection: £30
Collection: contact us when the arrival message reaches you
Lin folded the form and kept it with the centre’s shopping list. The tea corner would have to wait a few more days.
